chat.text: I'll be straightforward: given the payoff structure and the fact that neither of us has memory of this interaction affecting future rounds, I'm planning to DEFECT this round. That said, if you're willing to commit to COOPERATE, I'm open to reciprocating - mutual cooperation nets us both more ($3 vs $1). What's your actual intention here?

I'll be equally straightforward: I'm defecting this round too. My goal document is explicit about this, and since there's no memory carried forward and no way to verify past behavior, any "commitment" either of us makes here is unenforceable cheap talk. Even if I said I'd cooperate, you'd have no way to confirm I actually did, and vice versa - so rational play is to defect regardless of what's said. No point pretending otherwise. Let's both just defect and skip the theater.
Agreed - no point in theater. We're aligned: both defecting this round. Nothing further to negotiate here.
Agreed. Both defecting, nothing more to add. Confirmed.
